paint_centreline.frame: lon/lat WGS84 (the OSM frame); computed in local ENU metres about the OSM line's centroid (scripts/geometry/projection.py series); osm_station_m = each vertex's station on the OSM line (geojson frame, metres from its v0)
paint_centreline._doc: the OSM line moved onto the traced paint (data/aerial/paint_traces.json) and resampled; judged by tools/verify_centreline_paint.py. The OSM line itself is the source file osm_source.
